summary: Tested character sheet page features for Lord of the Rings 5e RPG app. All reported bugs are FIXED. The 'Gestionar' button in Equipment section now opens the Equipment Manager Modal correctly. All new sections (Apariencia Física, Rasgos de Personalidad, Senda de Sombra, Historia Personal, Virtud) are displaying properly with their respective data. The weight-summary endpoint correctly includes peso_total_montura (rider weight + equipment on mount). Three columns are now visually balanced (all equal height: 2044px).
critical_code_review_comments: CharacterSheetPage.jsx correctly passes isOpen and onCharacterUpdate props to EquipmentManagerModal
EquipmentManagerModal.jsx displays mount weight as 'jinete+equipo' in the header
New sections properly render in right column: Apariencia Física, Rasgos de Personalidad, Senda de Sombra
weight-summary endpoint returns new fields: peso_corporal, peso_total_montura
context_for_next_testing_agent: Character sheet page at /character/{id} has been fully tested. All sections working: HP, Shadow, Competencias (left column), Atributos, Habilidades, Ocupación, Equipo (middle column), Apariencia Física, Rasgos de Personalidad, Senda de Sombra, Trasfondo, Virtud, Cultura (right column). Equipment modal opens correctly.
